name: resource-table-card
title: ResourceTableCard
purpose: Resource index with status, metadata, row selection, and creation action.
avoidFor: Unrelated content forced into one surface
Pinned geometry or elevation that bypasses the active theme
accessibility: Heading level follows the surrounding document hierarchy.
Interactive controls retain native keyboard and focus behavior through Balsa primitives.
Supporting text and status do not rely on color alone.
commonMistakes: Pinning radius, border, or shadow instead of inheriting the design context.
Replacing the typed data contract with demo-only DOM.
Adding a second principal card surface.
